title: Used To Love This App
body:
Have been using alarmy on-and-off since 2017. I have recommended it to dozens of people. You couldn’t access all the features, but that was okay as the free alarm features were great. 
But when you began charging for more than half of the original “wake up” activities (that USED TO BE free!!!), I was not amused. 

The amount of ads playing have increased 10x what used to be there. I end up clicking dozens of them when waking up, so I’m giving you a lot of money through clicks. 

The icing on the cake is that you decreased the volume of the alarm!!! And you have to PAY to access the “other 70% of sound function.” 

So now, what used to be a loud alarm with loads of “wake up” features is just a money grab 😭

I now cannot wake up as I have severe insomnia and this alarm just useless. If you had ADDED features I may have considered paying, but the fact you are now charging for features that were previously free, is just scammy. I have started telling people to avoid the app, and will no longer be recommending it. 

Every time I try to post this review, it doesn’t get posted which is very suspicious.

title: MAJOR bugs + battery drain
body:
Deleted app once I noticed how much of a battery drain it is. How does an alarm clock app cause more drain on my battery than any other app on my phone?!

I will keep using the free version because it’s the only alarm I’ve found that will play through my headphones (thus not disturbing my partner when it goes off) and also plays downloaded songs from Apple Music. However, the severe and sometimes unpredictable bugs mean that it is not currently worth paying a subscription fee for to open up the locked features. Bugs include.. 1. The option to turn the alarm sound off when completing missions randomly and frequently decides not to work. Because of this I’ve uninstalled the alarm a few times to turn it off rather than complete the missions. 2. It is not optimised for my screen. The sleep quality screen is completely useless because a lot of it is not visible as it is severely zoomed in. Missions are also zoomed in and the bottom cut off the screen. This makes completing (particularly the memory game) difficult as the bottom row of boxes can barely be seen.
